subject: Security evidence & pen test timing for FastPay evaluation
message_1_subject: Security evidence & pen test timing for FastPay evaluation
message_1_body:
Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. As we formalize our MAP and close timeline, security is gating sign-off. I have a few concrete asks to close our evaluation by end of next quarter: 

- Can you share a controls matrix or SOC 2 artifact showing coverage for: access control, change management, logging/monitoring, and incident response? (PDF preferred)
- What is your standard retention for application and auth audit logs (syslog/event-store)? We need confirmation that logs are retained for 13 months for our compliance baseline.
- We’d like to schedule a vendor pen test window (internal procurement requirement). What scope does Redwood require/allow and who on your side owns coordination?
- We’ll need a signed DPA and a short note on your subprocessor list.

I’ve attached our evaluation checklist and initial timeline. If we can get owners and ETAs for the items above by next Tuesday (5/30), we can lock the MAP milestones.

Appreciate it—
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Security Programs, FastPay
alex.chen@fastpay.com
message_2_subject: Re: Security evidence & pen test timing for FastPay evaluation
message_2_body:
Alex — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and a proposed MAP checkpoint plan below; see attachments for the controls matrix and draft pen test scope. I’ll run this in our weekly MAP checkpoint and update owners/ETA in Monday’s meeting notes.

Quick answers: 
- Controls matrix: attached (SOC2_Controls_Matrix.pdf). It maps our documented controls to the common Trust Services Criteria.
- Audit log retention: standard is 12 months on our hosted tier; for Dedicated/Private we can extend to 13 months with a config change + note in the contract (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Pen test: we support both vendor-led and customer-led red team tests. Draft scope attached (pen_test_scope.docx). Coordination owner: marissa_cole will be the point for scheduling and scoping.
- DPA & subprocessors: procurement team will get the DPA sent via DocuSign today; summary of subprocessors in the controls matrix appendix.

Proposed MAP checkpoint / action items (for the weekly status email and meeting):
1) Provide finalized SOC2 artifact (PDF) — Owner: stephanie_nguyen — ETA: 2028-05-30
2) Confirm log retention configuration for FP account (12->13 months) — Owner: karthik_iyer — ETA: 2028-05-29
3) Finalize pen test window and scope sign-off — Owner: marissa_cole — ETA: 2028-06-07 (proposed window 6/14–6/21)
4) DPA signed and returned — Owner: ben_carter — ETA: 2028-05-31

Meeting: Weekly MAP checkpoint (security track) — proposed: Tue 5/30 11:00 PT (30m). If that works for you we’ll send calendar invite and an agenda with the three highest-priority asks.

I’ll summarize progress each week in this thread so the MAP remains a single source of truth.

Thanks—
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
message_3_subject: Re: Security evidence & pen test timing for FastPay evaluation
message_3_body:
Alex / Stephanie — adding technical clarifications for the MAP action on logs and evidence.

- Log retention: Hosted API uses object lifecycle on S3 with a 12-month default retention policy; we can extend to 13 months for the FP tenant by adding a lifecycle rule and updating the logging pipeline. I’ll create a PR for infra config and confirm once applied. (Tech owner: karthik_iyer)
- Audit logs/evidence location: we publish aggregate audit reports and CSV exports to the controlled Drive folder and can provide a signed attestation for the current period. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFASTPAY-evidence
- Pen test requirements: For vendor tests we require a short list of IP addresses and a maintenance window; no production DB dumps or privileged exploit attempts without prior coordination. We can accept scoped authenticated scans.

Actioning now: I’ll post the lifecycle change ticket and a short runbook by 5/29.

message_4_subject: Re: Security evidence & pen test timing for FastPay evaluation
message_4_body:
Thanks — confirm the Tue 5/30 11:00 PT checkpoint works for our side. Two quick clarifications before the meeting: 

1) For the SOC2 artifact, can you include the last test date and auditor name in the PDF header? That helps our procurement team.
2) On the pen test: FastPay legal needs a brief list of scope exclusions (e.g., no social-engineering, no third-party service tampering). If you can add the exclusions to the draft scope we can get internal sign-off faster.

We’ll plan to review the three owners/ETAs in the call and lock the MAP milestones if the DPA arrives by EOD Friday (5/31).

Meeting invite looks good — see you then.

—Alex
